name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This balances visibility for users who rely on focus indicators with the need to keep the interface clean and uncluttered. The 2px offset prevents overlap with text or other elements, reducing visual noise. Trade-off: thicker rings may feel slightly heavier in dense interfaces, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs this.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Use a 3px ring with 3px offset instead—it shrinks to 2.6px visible width at 1.25x zoom but meets contrast on most themes. Settle by testing with a screen reader and color contrast analyzer on live UI.
